# MBMS Podcast Studio

> Podcast production studio based in Marlow, Buckinghamshire, UK, recording in London studios, on location and remotely. We record, edit, publish and promote podcasts for businesses, and help them turn each episode into clips, posts and articles for their wider marketing.

MBMS Podcast Studio was founded by Damien and has a marketing background, with experience across B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, insurance technology, healthcare, retail and the video games industry, both agency-side and in-house. As well as recording and editing, we help clients shape the idea, plan guests and turn each conversation into content that supports their business goals. We record at venues in London including Hale House, bring a RØDE mobile studio to clients' offices and events in Marlow, the Thames Valley, London and beyond, and record remote guests with Riverside.

## Services and guide prices

- Recording session: £250 for up to 90 minutes, including studio preparation, sound check, monitoring and raw audio files
- Audio editing: from £175 per episode
- Audio and video editing: from £350 per episode
- Edited transcripts: from £85 per episode
- Show notes and episode descriptions: from £95 per episode
- Uploading, scheduling and distribution across the major podcast platforms
- Complete package (recording, editing, show notes, distribution and three social clips): from around £950 per episode
- Monthly packages for regular customers
- Clips from an existing YouTube podcast: 5 captioned short clips from £195 per episode, 10 clips from £345 per episode, monthly clips (up to 20 a month) from £595 a month
- Social clips for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, supporting posts and articles, and campaign alignment

Prices are guidelines, not fixed rates.

## Our podcast

- The Pod Pivot: a short, sharp show (25 to 35 minutes) for founders, marketers and business owners who are thinking about starting a podcast, or who already have one and aren't getting what they hoped for from it. Listen on Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/57sq8LLsrorHbcUvYFdcgx or Apple Podcasts: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-pod-pivot/id6817449302
